Section B shows a two-terminal block with end terminations (BW). Hash comparison: A5 baseline: none. A5 recorded no datasheet URL or SHA-256 for C15850 (engineering/a5/passive_evidence/C15850.snapshot.json carries no dataManualUrl/dataManualOfficialLink and engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json has no entry), so there is no A5 hash to compare; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/download, 3011022 bytes, starts %PDF-, 38 pages; GET and the product page's POST form return identical bytes): f0fc85a253cc95f38950a4406c88834f52c4b7697226692cafbb98fbb7c5727a - no A5 baseline.

sources.document_title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics SPECIFICATION (Reference Sheet) for CL21A106KAYNNNE, Multi-layer Ceramic Capacitor, with appended MLCC Product Manual
sources.locator: Section C Samsung Reliability Test and Judgement Condition table, rows Capacitance, Withstanding Voltage and Temperature Characteristics
sources.evidence_extract: Capacitance: within specified tolerance at 1kHz+/-10%, 1.0+/-0.2Vrms. Withstanding Voltage: no breakdown at 250% of the rated voltage. Temperature Characteristics X5R: from -55C to 85C capacitance change within +/-15%. Hash comparison: A5 baseline: none. A5 recorded no datasheet URL or SHA-256 for C15850 (engineering/a5/passive_evidence/C15850.snapshot.json carries no dataManualUrl/dataManualOfficialLink and engineering/a5/electronics/source_provenance.json has no entry), so there is no A5 hash to compare; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08, HTTP 200, Content-Type application/download, 3011022 bytes, starts %PDF-, 38 pages; GET and the product page's POST form return identical bytes): f0fc85a253cc95f38950a4406c88834f52c4b7697226692cafbb98fbb7c5727a - no A5 baseline. The High Temperature Resistance and Temperature Cycling rows use 'Max. operating temperature' and 'Min. operating temperature' as test conditions without printing a number; the only numeric temperature span on the sheet is the X5R row (-55 C to 85 C). Row added 2026-11-11 from bytes re-downloaded by the cloud VM (HTTP 200, application/pdf) whose SHA-256 is identical to this record's; text layer read with pdftotext -layout on that page.

sources.document_title: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC product page CL21A106KAYNNN (DC Bias characteristic graph data)
sources.locator: figure DC Bias graph: embedded chart JSON object graphType 'DCBias', chartList data rows (x = DC voltage in V, y = capacitance change in %)
sources.evidence_extract: DCBias graph for partsName CL21A106KAYNNN: conditions degC 25.0, measuring frequency 1 kHz, signal 1.0 Vrms (fields dsDcFre / dsDcSign), axis 'DeltaC'. Tabulated points used: -50.31 % at 5.0 V; -81.6 % at 12.208 V; 3.3368 V point -30.95 %; curve 0 to 25 V ends at -92.71 % at 25 V; no tabulated point at exactly 12 V (nearest 12.208 V). Page text: 'This page includes the typical data for design reference only.' The HTML was fetched by the cloud VM (HTTP 200, text/html); values were read from the embedded chart JSON, sorted by voltage, at tabulated points without interpolation.
sources.authority_note: Samsung Electro-Mechanics is the manufacturer; the page itself labels the graph data as typical and for design reference only, so it is a typical curve, not a guaranteed minimum. The page is generated live and embeds a server timestamp and a dt= cache-buster, so every re-fetch returns different bytes and an online hash re-check of this entry will always report a stale hash. The hash pins the retained 2026-11-12 snapshot only; it is HASH-LOCKED because the framework allows VOLATILE-HTML only for distributor identity pages. A re-check must compare the embedded DCBias chart data, which was identical across two fetches on 2026-11-12.
